title: Name why the cache probe answered in 698 ms on Windows CI and fix or bound it
goal: The F-121-T04 cache probe never waits behind the slicer, and its test holds on a loaded Windows runner
acceptance: Whether the probe waited behind the 600 ms fake slicer (a code cause) or the runner was slow is named from the run output and a local reproduction under load
A code cause gets a failing-first regression and a fix; a runner cause gets a bound stated in the test that still fails when the probe queues behind the slicer
test/print-transfer.test.ts passes in the next five Windows CI runs without a rerun
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 in the reconciliation from B-127-T01 (a load investigation, 1 h): read the log, reproduce under load, fix or bound. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-26.
